title: The character sheet comes first
summary: Players' character sheets open straight to the sheet, with quicker HP changes and the last roll in view.
items: Your character opens straight to the sheet, with Home › Character sheet above it; your character library and import wait below, opened from Sheet tools.
When the DM locks editing, a small lock beside Edit sheet says so instead of a banner.
The save bar appears only while you have unsaved edits, so it no longer covers the dice tray.
−1 HP and +1 HP beside your vitals save at once, and Last roll shows your latest result next to Jump to dice tray.
Import into this character moved into Sheet tools.
In a shared room, a character's roll log no longer says it is saved on this device.
